items.summary:
Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 72 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy. 
Claude Code Game Studios 
 Turn a single Claude Code session into a full game development studio.  49 agents. 74 skills. One coordinated AI team.  
 
          
 
Why This Exists 
Building a game solo with AI is powerful — but a single chat session has no structure. No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing sp

confirmed_facts.text: No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: No one stops you from hardcoding magic numbers, skipping design docs, or writing spaghetti code.

confirmed_facts.text: There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?" Claude Code Game Studios solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: There's no QA pass, no design review, no one asking "does this actually fit the game's vision?" Claude Code Game Studios solves this by giving your AI session the structure of a real studio.

confirmed_facts.text: Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the hands-on work.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Instead of one general-purpose assistant, you get 49 specialized agents organized into a studio hierarchy — directors who guard the vision, department leads who own their domains, and specialists who do the hands-on work.

confirmed_facts.text: The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches mistakes early, and keeps your project organized from first brainstorm to launch.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The result: you still make every decision, but now you have a team that asks the right questions, catches mistakes early, and keeps your project organized from first brainstorm to launch.

confirmed_facts.text: Agents are organized into three tiers, matching how real studios operate: Tier 1 — Directors creative-director technical-director producer Tier 2 — Department Leads game-designer lead-programmer art-director audio-director narrative-director qa-lead release-manager localization-l
